description: This file defines a helper class 'SavingsProductHelper' used for constructing, manipulating, and performing operations related to savings product entities in the Apache Fineract integration test suite. It includes methods for building JSON representations, setting various properties, creating, updating, and retrieving savings products, as well as internal methods for account mappings based on accounting rules.

classes.name: SavingsProductHelper
classes.description: A helper class to facilitate creation, configuration, and CRUD operations for savings products during integration tests. Includes methods to build JSON payloads, set properties, and perform server interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing the savings product with current property values.

methods.name: urlSavingsUpdate
methods.description: Generates the URL for updating a specific savings product by its ID.

methods.name: withSavingsName
methods.description: Sets the name of the savings product.

methods.name: withInterestCompoundingPeriodTypeAsDaily
methods.description: Sets the interest compounding period type to daily.

methods.name: withMinimumOpenningBalance
methods.description: Sets the minimum required opening balance.

methods.name: withInterestCompoundingPeriodTypeAsMonthly
methods.description: Sets interest compounding period type to monthly.

methods.name: withInterestCompoundingPeriodTypeAsAnnually
methods.description: Sets interest compounding period type to annually.

methods.name: withInterestPostingPeriodTypeAsMonthly
methods.description: Sets interest posting period type to monthly.

methods.name: withMinBalanceForInterestCalculation
methods.description: Sets the minimum balance for interest calculation.

methods.name: withInterestPostingPeriodTypeAsQuarterly
methods.description: Sets interest posting period type to quarterly.

methods.name: withInterestPostingPeriodTypeAsAnnual
methods.description: Sets interest posting period type to annual.

methods.name: withInterestPostingPeriodTypeAsDaily
methods.description: Sets interest posting period type to daily.

methods.name: withInterestCalculationPeriodTypeAsDailyBalance
methods.description: Configures interest calculation using daily balance.

methods.name: withInterestCalculationPeriodTypeAsAverageDailyBalance
methods.description: Configures interest calculation using average daily balance.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsNone
methods.description: Sets accounting rule to 'None'.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsAccrualBased
methods.description: Sets accounting rule to 'Accrual Based' and assigns account list.

methods.name: withAccountingRuleAsCashBased
methods.description: Sets accounting rule to 'Cash Based' and assigns account list.

methods.name: withMinRequiredBalance
methods.description: Defines minimum required balance.

methods.name: withEnforceMinRequiredBalance
methods.description: Enforces minimum required balance.

methods.name: withLienAllowed
methods.description: Allows lien on the savings product with specified limit.

methods.name: withOverDraft
methods.description: Configures overdraft limit.

methods.name: withAccountInterestReceivables
methods.description: Sets interest receivable account ID.

methods.name: withOverDraftRate
methods.description: Sets overdraft related interest rates.

methods.name: withWithHoldTax
methods.description: Configures tax withholding group.

methods.name: withgsimID
methods.description: Sets the gSIM ID.

methods.name: withCurrencyCode
methods.description: Overrides the default currency code.

methods.name: withNominalAnnualInterestRate
methods.description: Sets the nominal annual interest rate.

methods.name: withSavingsReferenceAccountId
methods.description: Associates a savings reference account.

methods.name: withSavingsControlAccountId
methods.description: Sets savings control account ID.

methods.name: withInterestOnSavingsAccountId
methods.description: Sets interest-on savings account ID.

methods.name: withIncomeFromFeeAccountId
methods.description: Sets income from fee account ID.

methods.name: withInterestPayableAccountId
methods.description: Sets interest payable account ID.

methods.name: withOverdraftPortfolioControlId
methods.description: Sets overdraft portfolio control account ID.

methods.name: withInterestReceivableAccountId
methods.description: Sets interest receivable account ID.

methods.name: withIncomeFromInterestId
methods.description: Sets income from interest ID.

methods.name: getNominalAnnualInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the nominal annual interest rate as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getNominalAnnualInterestRateOverdraft
methods.description: Returns the overdraft nominal annual interest rate as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation days in year type as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getDecimalCurrency
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal digits for currency.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Performs server request to create a savings product with given JSON.

methods.name: updateSavingsProduct
methods.description: Performs server request to update a savings product by ID with given JSON.

methods.name: verifySavingsProductCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies the savings product creation on server by matching ID.

methods.name: withDormancy
methods.description: Enables dormancy tracking with preset days thresholds.

methods.name: getSavingsProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific savings product by ID from server.
